description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named NoteController for managing notes. It exposes CRUD endpoints such as listing all notes, retrieving a note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes. The controller uses Spring Boot annotations and integrates Swagger/OpenAPI documentation. It interacts with a NoteService for business logic and handles validation errors.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for notes, built with Spring Boot framework.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all notes.

methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID via PUT request.

methods.description: Deletes a note by ID via DELETE request.
